description.value: Floyd's Diner is a Victoria-area landmark established in 2004, famous as 'Home of the Mahoney' and known for satisfying portions in a fun, family-friendly atmosphere. This is the Langford location, the chain's second, opened in 2012. Touring cyclists riding through the Langford corridor will find it a solid breakfast-and-lunch stop open seven days a week.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 28m; rack at 44m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this OSM record corresponds to the Langford location of Floyd's Diner at 721 Station Ave, one of four locations in the Victoria area. The Langford phone (778-440-1200) appears on the website but is absent from OSM. A postal code mismatch exists (OSM: V9B 2S1, website: V9B 5R5), and the website spells the name 'Floyd's Diner' with an apostrophe while OSM omits it. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Floyds Diner' (no apostrophe); website consistently uses 'Floyd's Diner'.
Postal code mismatch: OSM has V9B 2S1; website lists V9B 5R5 for the Langford location.
Phone absent from OSM; website lists 778-440-1200 for the Langford (721 Station Ave) location — used here.
OSM community field is 'Victoria' but 721 Station Ave is in Langford municipality.
Multi-location chain — OSM record covers only the Langford location; other locations (James Bay, Royal Oak, Gorge) are separate and not represented here.

A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify at least bike parking before including.
